title: Lioness
summary: A lioness that lives on the uninhabited Indonesian island, near the Phoenix Volcano, approached Tersly while he was navigating the Huntik team through the underground labyrinth of the Lodestone. She was interested in his radio equipment before noticing him, advancing on him with the intention of eating him. When Lok Lambert managed to destroy the Lodestone and disable the anti-magic field, Tersly was able to summon Venadek who cut down some logs, scaring the lioness away. [The Dead Magic Island]
